title: Za'Darius Smith retired last season to be with his mother before she died

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Za'Darius Smith retired last season to be with his mother before she died
sources.description: Za'Darius Smith's retirement took the Eagles by surprise last season and the veteran outside linebacker explained the decision in his first press conference since coming out of retirement to join the Falcons.
